en: A colored illustration of a European townscape viewed from an elevated position. In the foreground are small houses with red or brown tiled roofs, narrow streets, and a few pedestrians. Behind them is a belt of trees, and beyond that a hilltop complex with several towers and domes. Most prominent are two tall, narrow, identical church towers flanking a white façade in the center-left, and additional church or civic towers and a large greenish dome to the right. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.
